note: Houghton County has no countywide zoning; townships and cities zone their own land. City of Houghton publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (2024 tax-zoning map) and ordinance text; City of Hancock publishes its Chapter 154 zoning map as a PDF inside the ordinance; Portage Township and Chassell Township publish zoning only as PDF ordinances/maps. The WUPPDR/Beacon parcel viewer lists zoning as a topic but exposes no queryable zoning district service, and the ArcGIS Online and Hub searches found no zoning district layer for Houghton County or its cities.
